notes.title: Release notes v0.7.6.0
notes.content: [p]By popular request, Brazilian Portuguese and Russian have been added to the game![/p][p]I have also made multiple improvements and fixes based on suggestions and bug reports.[/p][p]After this update, I will focus on the Civilizations update, releasing only minor patches to fix any critical bugs.[/p][p]The plan is to release a major update with the Civilization's Early Ages, gather player feedback, make fixes and changes, and when the Civilizations implementation looks good, release another update including the Modern Ages.[/p][p][/p][p][b]New features[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added Brazilian Portuguese translation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added Russian translation.[/p][/*][*][p]Added temperature scale selector between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin.[/p][/*][*][p]Added key binding menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Added shortcuts to open all main menus.[/p][/*][*][p]Added taxonomy for plants and fungi names.[/p][/*][*][p]Now, you can switch views using TAB.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Trees will only be completely devoured by huge creatures (other creatures can eat trees, but they will not destroy them).[/p][/*][*][p]Tiny creatures will not destroy plants when they eat them.[/p][/*][*][p]Volcanoes generate CO2 now.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed bug in water movement simulation that was making the sea not be leveled.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug allowing to delete components that are dependencies of others, allowing an exploit for unexpected combinations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed water and terrain borders forming strange shapes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bad elevation positioning of elements in the terrain.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed bug causing exoskeleton to be excluded from random mutations.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed star system configuration preview not showing.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed fins positioning wrong, specially after devolve from legs.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved grass pop-up in walking camera.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Steam connection errors.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Demo update v0.5.7
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Here a new update of Planetary Life demo, and this time yes! This will be the last one unless I have to do some hot fixes related to bugs or balancing.

No more new features, no more additions until the game gets released :-)

In this new update you will find the following:

[b]New features[/b]
[list]
[*] Added “Observer” option. This mode is ideal to leave the game running automatically. Instead of stay in a fixed point because of the inaction of the player, it will move the camera automatically focusing on major events. This option is ideal for long run streaming as well.
[*] In screen stand-alone message for most recent notification.
[*] Added individual mutation rate parameter for plants.
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Now vegetarians will eat plants and reduce the amount them, with a possibility of remove all vegetation in the area.
[*] Nutritional values of plants affect the hungry levels of creatures.
[*] Moved a bit away the planet’s ring to avoid being to close to the global camera.
[/list]

[b]Bugs fixed[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug causing the game to freeze.
[*] Fixed bug applying wrong texture to creature’s sprite animation.
[*] Fixed bug causing wild fire events to spawn in areas with no vegetation or water.
[/list]

Also, here a summary of most important changes between version 0.5.0 and this update (ignoring previously mentioned changes, bug fixed and other minor stuff):
[list]
[*] Changed how evolution menu works: now you can do many changes, but each change will have a cost. At the end, the price of all changes will be subtracted from your energy.
[*] Added “undo last change” button to creature/plant editor to undo step by step all done changes and also to avoid players getting stuck.
[*] Improved rain effect.
[*] Mutated creatures will have a 25% chance to get adapted their temperature to the new location.
[*] Improved atmosphere, showing a bluer sky and stars at night.
[*] Now mutation rate artifact can change to decreasing the rate.
[*] Now reproduction rate artifact can change to decreasing the rate.
[*] Added artifact to change humidity in the area.
[*] Added mouth noises to creatures.
[*] Added proper omnivore, carnivore and vegetarian separated plots for Stats screen.
[/list]

ENJOY the demo!!! 
And see you soon when the game gets released in Early Access!

notes.title: Devlog #6 - The Cell Stage explained!
notes.content: [previewyoutube=R6EmCYkM5-s;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Cell stage is here!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

It's been a while since the last update!

Over the past few months, I have been working on something totally new and unexpected.
This was out of the original scope of the game, but it was requested from some people and decided to add it.


It was more challenging than expected, specially in terms of gameplay.
I could have taken the usual approach of player controlling one cell in an arcade-style game. moving around the scenario, feeding, evading larger cells and eventually evolving into something bigger.

However, this didn't match with the original philosophy of the game, where you have full control of a planet and its ecosystem, therefore you are not just controlling one creature or specie, but everything!

So, this cell stage was designed as a kind of [b]Petri dish[/b], where you will find a variety of cells moving, reproducing and evolving.

As a player, you can influence them and and guide their evolution manually.
At some point, basic cells will evolve into multicellular life forms, and later, when those are enough evolved, you will be able to evolve one more time and create a macroscopic life form ending this stage.

The outcome could be a creature, a plant or a fungi with different properties based on the evolved multicellular properties.

Optionally, you can ignore this part and just create some basic life forms in the planet using a template. Although, these templates won't cover all the possibilities.

For now, [b][u]this part won't be included in the current demo[/u][/b], but I hope everyone enjoys this new feature when the game is released.

notes.title: Demo Update 0.4.0
notes.content:
I know it's been a while, I'm sorry!

But it's for a good reason... a new rendering system!

What that means? Well... I added a new camera to the game that allow players to [b]walk and explore planet's surface[/b]! 
Because of this, I needed to rebuild the whole rendering system of the game, and also redo many of the assets, because initially were designed for a top-down view but now you can watch them from any angle.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249602/c9c230420e6d5ae9966da0217ca3f47bdeed83bd.png[/img]

Also, I fully implement the vegetation system including allowing the players to evolve them and generate procedural plants and trees.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249602/fbc353cd121544a610b34a6e49461861afb4e30e.png[/img]

Along with this demo, there are many other changes and improvements, but I will summary them in the following release note.

I hope you enjoy this new version of the demo!

The demo of Planetary Life is out now!

You can already experience a small portion of the game and we're excited for you to try it out.

It's important to know that this demo is from an early access game, so it stills requires polishing, bug fixing, game balancing and adding more features.

We're committed to making improvements, and your feedback is incredibly important to us!

Any bugs, aspects you dislike, or if you simply wish to share your enthusiasm about the game, feel free to do so in the discussion area or in our official Discord.


[color=red]Disclaimer![/color]

Please be aware that in addition to encountering bugs, this demo does not feature all the components planned for the final game.

[b]Not included features:[/b]
- Simulation and evolution of plants (includes highly simplified version of the plants).
- Several types of food that depended on plants: pollen, flowers and fruits.
- The gases of the planet, although present, have no effect on the creatures for the moment.
- This demo contains 58 different components to evolve creatures only. The final game will have much more.
- The cell stage is not available in this demo.
- The civilization stage is not available in this demo.
- In this demo is [color=orange]not possible to Save/Load[/color] the game.

I hope you enjoy this demo and we await your valuable feedback and your wishlist on Steam!

Thank you for playing!

notes.title: Introducing Artifacts in Planetary Life
notes.content:
Have you ever wished to wield the power to shape the very fabric of your planet? Well, look no further! Enter the realm of artifacts—extraordinary items that, once strategically placed, can unleash a myriad of effects, transforming your surroundings either locally or globally.

Imagine a world where you have the ability to combine and stack these artifacts, creating a symphony of powerful effects that can elevate your planetary experience to new heights. 

Today, we're diving into the fascinating universe of planetary artifacts, starting with the most fundamental one.

[h2]Get planet energy[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Earth ⛰️

The purpose of this Artifact is to serve as a planetary resource extractor, gathering energy to power a variety of tools and artifacts within our arsenal.

[previewyoutube=1ASxPqT51hg;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Change surface albedo[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Earth ⛰️

This artifact has the capability to adjust the global surface albedo of the planet, either increasing or decreasing temperatures to make the climate hotter or cooler.

[previewyoutube=oO41bbPXkwU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Change core heat[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Fire 🔥

Adjusting the global core heat of the planet, whether increasing or decreasing, directly impacts the activity of volcanoes.

[previewyoutube=4oTHfP7h7S8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Change cloud albedo[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Air ☁️

Much like the surface albedo, this artifact has the capacity to influence global planet temperatures, either making them hotter or cooler.

[previewyoutube=qfnLusfFbGw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Change temperature[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Air ☁️

Employing this artifact alters the temperature of the designated area. Enhance the impact by stacking multiple identical artifacts in the same region to amplify the effect.

[previewyoutube=6vYY1BzV8nQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Change wind direction[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Air ☁️

Manipulate wind direction to shift clouds and moisture to various locations as you see fit.

[previewyoutube=xf2OGdNkoxM;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Increase reproduction rate[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Life 🦠

This will enhance the reproduction rate within the designated area.

[previewyoutube=_p4p1IITlho;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Increase mutation rate[/h2]
[b]Category[/b]: Life 🦠

This will elevate the mutation rate in the region, accelerating the evolutionary process for the creatures inhabiting it.

[previewyoutube=PvmgYPRlBmo;full][/previewyoutube]
